name: Baker's Fresh Produce & Honey
tagline: Baker's Fresh Produce & Honey — Arugula in Wadsworth, OH
description: Baker's Fresh Produce & Honey is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 8927 River Styx Rd, OH. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
